sources.title: Can Gemini 3 pass the Bar Exam? At this point, who cares.
sources.excerpt: More interestingly, what does Gemini 3 think about its ability to pass the Bar Exam?

reasoning: In March 2023, researchers Daniel Martin Katz and Michael J. Bommarito II published a study demonstrating that OpenAI's GPT-4 successfully passed the Uniform Bar Exam (UBE) with a score of 297. This score is well above the passing threshold of 260 to 270 required by US jurisdictions. While the authors initially reported that GPT-4 scored in the 90th percentile, a subsequent re-evaluation by researcher Eric Martinez argued that this figure was inflated because it was compared against lower-scoring February test-takers (who are disproportionately repeat takers). Martinez's revised estimate placed GPT-4's performance at approximately the 68th percentile across all test-takers (and the 48th percentile among July first-time test-takers). Because a score in the 68th percentile overall is above average, and newer frontier models (such as GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet) have shown even greater capabilities, the claim is accurate.
title: AI systems now pass the bar exam
